svg.title: Pi Zero 2 W UART wiring — physical pins 6, 8 and 10
svg.desc: Component-side header view. Physical pin 1 is at lower left and pin 2 at upper left. Pin 6 is ground, pin 8 is GPIO14 transmit, and pin 10 is GPIO15 receive. Connect ground to ground, Pi transmit to adapter receive, and adapter transmit to Pi receive. Use 3.3 volt logic.

g.text: Highlighted numbers are physical header pins. GPIO numbers are different.
Header orientation: pin 1 = lower left; pin 2 = upper left, as drawn above.
Use 3.3 V UART logic. Power the Pi separately via PWR IN; leave adapter VCC disconnected.
Adapted from Pinout.xyz by Gadgetoid · CC BY-SA 4.0
UART wiring annotations by Amrish Hallberg · diagram adaptation CC BY-SA 4.0
